faq.title: Common questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about the AI Teacher Copilot platform.
faq.contactFallback: Didn't find your answer? Reach out to our support team.
faq.q1: How does AI Teacher Copilot use AI to generate content?
faq.a1: We use a RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architecture. When generating lesson plans or quizzes, the system retrieves relevant chunks from your indexed documents and provides them as trusted context to Gemini AI, ensuring grounded and hallucination-free outputs.
faq.q2: Are my documents shared with others?
faq.a2: Not at all. Each Workspace is strictly isolated with tenant-level boundaries. Your documents are only accessible within your specific workspace. Strict access control prevents data leakage across accounts.
faq.q3: What file types can I upload?
faq.a3: We currently support PDF and DOCX files. You can upload textbooks, reference sheets, existing lesson plans, sample tests, or any curriculum materials. Our parser extracts clean text and document structure.
faq.a4: Every multiple choice and short answer question is classified into 6 cognitive levels: Remember, Understand, Apply, Analyze, Evaluate, and Create. This ensures balanced exam difficulty according to educational standards.
faq.a5: Every section and question references specific source chunk IDs and page numbers from your uploaded files. Teachers can inspect the original source text at any time to verify correctness.
faq.q6: Can I edit the AI-generated content?
faq.a6: Yes. AI outputs are treated as editable drafts. Teachers maintain full authority to edit, revise, regenerate with new instructions, or export. All versions are tracked in revision history.
